DrugFdaSort.description: Drugs@FDA application order; omitted keeps the source's own order.

DrugNameSelector.description: One explicit ChEMBL name filter without fallback or synonym expansion.
x-enum-descriptions: Match the native preferred name exactly, ignoring case.
Match an explicit native synonym exactly, ignoring case.

DrugRecallClassification.description: FDA's native recall classification, with no local ranking.

LabelApplicationType.description: An openFDA label's FDA application type, read from the prefix of openFDA's application_number.

PartialDate.description: A Gregorian date preserving year, month or day precision. The parser additionally validates the calendar day, including leap years.

Text.description: Bounded nonempty text with surrounding Unicode whitespace removed.

description: Search one drug source. FDA drug recalls accept a name or native firm, classification, status, reason and initiation dates; counts are recall records. WHO prequalification accepts a name, area or date range. openFDA labels also accept literal indication or mechanism wording. Drugs@FDA accepts a name or an applicant. Other sources require a name. Purple Book takes a reference name or BLA and summarizes biosimilars by product.

applicant.description: sponsor_name prefix. Ignores case, with no company-family or subsidiary inference. A drug name narrows results.

application_type.description:
Keep label application_number prefixes, e.g. nda,bla to; help search drug
Keep label application_number prefixes, e.g. nda,bla to exclude generics (ANDA).

approved_from.description: Earliest original_approval. Inclusive (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD). Reads all matches and counts those in range.

approved_to.description: Latest original_approval. Inclusive (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD).

classification.description:
FDA recall classification; help search drug
FDA recall classification.

device.description: Filter presentations by device cell, ignoring case.

exact_term.description: Use only the typed name. Default name widening applies to openFDA labels, Drugs@FDA, FDA recalls and safety communications, and EMA.

expand_drug_names.description: Accepted for one release. Name widening is already automatic where supported.

firm.description: Exact phrase in the published recall firm name.

indication.description: Exact Indications and Usage wording, without disease synonyms. A drug name narrows the search.

limit.description: Rows per page. Purple Book product summaries always return the full roster.

mechanism_of_action.description: Exact Mechanism of Action wording, without synonyms or drug class inference.

name_selector.description:
ChEMBL name to match. Default: preferred name; help search drug
ChEMBL name to match. Default: preferred name.

name_snapshot.description: Label name page token. Keep the first page's names and step by reusing the token with unchanged filters.

offset.description: Rows to skip. Purple Book applies this only to presentation rows.

prequalified_from.description: First WHO prequalification date. Inclusive (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD).

prequalified_to.description: Last WHO prequalification date. Inclusive (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD).

presentations.description: Return presentation rows, as do --strength and --device.

query.description:
Drug name phrase. Optional for recalls, safety communications, WHO dates, label indication or mechanism and Drugs@FDA applicant searches.
Drugs@FDA matches brands and ingredients by exact name, then by words. openFDA labels do the same for brands and generics,
then search label text (including indications) if no names match. Recall aliases can match without becoming display names.
Safety communications match titles, linked drug names and available text. Replies count records searched and records with page text.
A communication can exist even when the search returns zero matches.

sort.description:
Application order. newest uses latest submission status date,; help search drug
Application order. newest uses latest submission status date, which may be for a supplement.
original-approval reads all matches and sorts by original_approval. Both put recent dates first,
break ties by application number and put undated rows last. Omit for source order.

source.description:
Drug source. An empty name search may retry names from other; help search drug
Drug source. An empty name search may retry names from other sources.

strength.description: Filter presentations by strength cell, ignoring case and spaces.

therapeutic_area.description: WHO therapeutic area. Match whole words, ignoring case (e.g. Oncology).

title: DrugSearch
